statement: A whole-segment PEC-invalid image shall invalidate that segment and pack authority
The current path shall handle bootstrap precharge zero and sign stimuli without stale state
HPPC excitation shall qualify estimator convergence polarization and R0 behavior
Low-SoC discharge qualification shall exercise UV and SoC bindings
High-SoC charge qualification shall exercise OV SoC and sign bindings
Hot weak-group qualification shall preserve the limiting-group response
SoH qualification shall include rest-excursion-rest capacity and resistance evidence
Fuse qualification shall replay a deterministic transient through production and reference models
Measurement qualification shall cover stale dropout frozen-value and sequence faults
Dynamic qualification shall retain a reproducible 600 s profile
Current bias shall be bounded and its estimator effect reported
Loss of either required current channel shall invalidate the current measurement
Dual-range disagreement shall be detected rather than silently selecting authority
Current gain error shall be injected deterministically and scored
ADC rail or implausible current data shall fail closed
Positive discharge and negative charge polarity shall remain consistent end to end
Hall or ADC saturation shall not produce a valid unrestricted current value
Invalid current measurements shall never be accepted as zero calibration
A coherently biased segment shall be rejected by acquisition consensus without blocking healthy peers and shall reacquire after clean data returns without relaxing the clean convergence gate

Production startup estimation shall prevent unconstrained SoC/polarization allocation and use retryable consensus-gated fixed-basis relaxation acquisition when a qualified low-current window is available
Each of five segment EKFs shall converge from directed initial SoC error
Production estimation shall retain the full symmetric SoC Vp1 Vp2 covariance fail closed on invalid covariance and expose prior innovation variance for production NIS and state NEES scoring
Estimator behavior under current uncertainty shall be bounded and reported
Estimator behavior under bounded timing jitter shall remain numerically valid
High-SoC estimation shall remain bounded through charge transitions
Five segment estimators shall preserve segment isolation under group imbalance
Innovation bias rejection and variance shall be reported for every segment
Long-duration estimator execution shall have zero numerical divergence
Low-SoC estimation shall remain bounded near the discharge limit
Scalar normalized innovation squared shall use the estimator innovation variance
Nominal five-segment SoC error shall meet frozen RMSE p95 and maximum gates
R0 adaptation shall be scored while observable and checked for drift while unobservable
Estimator behavior shall be qualified at directed temperature corners
Estimator confidence floors shall react conservatively to measured temperature near the characterized electrical LUT edges and temperature cases shall report production NIS and state NEES
Endurance replay shall retain deterministic provenance and numerical health
Invalid stale or untrusted measurement images shall not create additional authority
Production fuse utilization shall not understate the independent exact-ZOH reference
Stale acquisition shall retain its last value while age and freshness invalidate it
Usable masks ages and validity shall control the published measurement image
Valid operation shall contain no NaN Inf negative variance or divergent state
Short qualifying-style current bursts shall exercise transient power behavior
Capacity SoH shall be scored independently from resistance growth
Capacity SoH shall remain invalid until rest excursion throughput and confidence requirements are met
Temperature-only resistance change shall not create persistent material aging
Capacity fade and resistance growth shall be varied and scored independently
Resistance growth and conservative upper bound shall be scored when observable
Temperature-dependent resistance shall be distinguished from irreversible aging
The 0.1 s SoP horizon shall be scored against the distributed oracle
The 1 s SoP horizon shall be scored against the distributed oracle
Production SoP authority shall fail closed while any enabled segment estimator has not completed qualified acquisition
Charge SoP shall use negative current convention and magnitude-safe comparison
Charge SoP shall enforce minimum and maximum temperature limits
The truth discharge envelope shall report electrothermal fuse and combined limits
SoP shall cover 0.1 1 10 and 30 s horizons with monotonic diagnostics
Charge SoP shall bind before any group exceeds the frozen overvoltage limit
SoP shall bind before any group exceeds its charge or discharge thermal limit
Discharge SoP shall bind before any group falls below the frozen undervoltage limit
Distributed SoP shall retain the actual limiting weak group
Temperature bias shall be injected deterministically and scored
Stale temperature shall not be treated as a fresh thermal authority input
Timestamp jitter and repeated sequence behavior shall be reproducible and bounded
Cell-voltage bias shall be injected per measurement image and reflected in innovation
